summary: IperionX Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a presentation titled 'Titan DFS' regarding a critical-mineral-to-metals platform for heavy rare earths and titanium. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report providing an investor or business update; it announces no transaction, no acquisition or divestiture, no tender offer, no going-private, no activist campaign, and no strategic review. No deal terms, prices, premiums, or board recommendations are present. This is not a special-situation filing but a standard disclosure under Rule 13a-16.
